rationale: With the Chief Justice in the majority and emphasizing Williams, fair notice, and administrability, Roberts is best positioned to assign and keep a broad coalition for a clear literal-falsity rule under § 1014. The most likely separate writings are Gorsuch/Thomas (lenity and textual limits on criminal expansion) and possibly Barrett (structural “false vs. false or misleading” drafting point) to sharpen the limiting principle without fracturing unanimity.
